name: Relic Town
title: Relic Town
summary: Relic Town is the ash-covered Empyrean ruin on Aerlinthe's inner harbour where the Relic Watchman spawns and Smith Ejan's whispers are heard. The acpedia map point (85.3N 45.5E) is on the empty slope; the ruins lie 250 m north at 86.2N 45.5E (matching acpedia's 'near 86.0N 45.4E' and the gazetteer statue at 86.4N 45.4E): terraces of grey stone towers and halls (z 12-46) with colonnades of grey metal and stone columns, statues, glowing sphere lamps and portalspace rifts atop the hall towers, eruption emitters, descending to the harbour. Landblocks north of y 45312 are missing from the kit; all cameras stay south of them.
insertNote: Kept the batch's route position (chapter ch2).

shots.standingOrder: Hang 48 m above the harbour shore 150 m east of the ruins and drift 8 deg while easing 6 % closer; nothing within 30 m, harbour water beneath.
shots.notes: Relic Town, the ash-covered Empyrean ruin on Aerlinthe's inner harbour: terraces of grey stone towers, halls and colonnades of metal columns climb from the water toward the volcano, glowing sphere lamps on the hall towers. Seen from the harbour with the noon sun from the left. The kit misses the landblocks north of y 45312; the move stays south of them.
